description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Claude Code/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: RBAC role admin writes reject ambiguous JSON request bodies
userStories.description: POST /api/admin/roles, PATCH /api/admin/roles/{name}, and PUT /api/admin/roles/{name}/permissions all currently call json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) directly. That accepts only the first JSON value and silently ignores trailing bytes, so a concatenated payload such as {"name":"safe"}{"permissions":["admin"]} can hide intent from auditors, proxies, and operators. Route all three handlers through httputil.ReadJSON so the single-JSON-value contract holds for the RBAC root surface.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given POST /api/admin/roles with a concatenated body of two JSON objects, when the handler decodes the request, then it returns 400 InvalidRoleRequest with a reason mentioning a single JSON value AND no role row is created.

Given PATCH /api/admin/roles/{name} for an existing custom role with a concatenated body, when the handler decodes the request, then it returns 400 InvalidRoleUpdate AND the stored description remains unchanged.

Given PUT /api/admin/roles/{name}/permissions for a custom role with a concatenated body, when the handler decodes the request, then it returns 400 InvalidPermissionsRequest AND the stored permissions remain unchanged.

Given a single well-formed JSON body for each of POST /api/admin/roles, PATCH, and PUT permissions, when the handler runs, then the existing 201/200 happy paths still succeed so the hardening does not regress legitimate clients.

userStories.title: Group admin writes reject ambiguous JSON request bodies
userStories.description: POST /api/admin/groups, PATCH /api/admin/groups/{name}, and the group-member assignment write at pkg/auth/group_handlers.go:340 still use json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req). Convert them to httputil.ReadJSON to close the same trailing-JSON smuggling gap on group-level RBAC writes.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given each group admin write surface with a concatenated body of two JSON objects, when the handler decodes the request, then it returns 400 with a reason mentioning a single JSON value AND no group/member state mutates.
Given a single well-formed JSON body for each surface, when the handler runs, then the existing happy paths still succeed.

userStories.title: Service-account admin writes reject ambiguous JSON request bodies
userStories.description: POST /api/admin/service-accounts and PATCH /api/admin/service-accounts/{id} at pkg/auth/service_account_handlers.go:108 and :256 still use json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req). Convert them to httputil.ReadJSON so trailing-JSON smuggling cannot bypass the single-value contract on service-account writes that mint long-lived identities.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given each service-account admin write surface with a concatenated body of two JSON objects, when the handler decodes the request, then it returns 400 with a reason mentioning a single JSON value AND no service-account state mutates.
Given a single well-formed JSON body for each surface, when the handler runs, then the existing happy paths still succeed.
